title: P1 quest talk request payload
description: DEC-TUTORIAL-TRANSPORT-20261106 approves POST /p1/quests/talk as an additive message, mapped only while P1:AlphaProfile and P1:QuestTalk are both on. The payload names the NPC and the narrative node and nothing else: the server never picks a first node on the client's behalf, and it derives the quest, the attempt, the objective and the speaker from its own state, so a request that names a questId, coordinates, a map or a flag is invalid_payload.

npcId.description: The speaker the actor is standing in front of. The server checks it against the node's own SpeakerNpcId; a mismatch is not a credit.

nodeId.description: An id from the narrative catalog pinned to the same content version. Unknown ids are refused before any quest state is touched.
